data.text:
Diamond Beverages Private Limited vs Food Safety Officer on
29 July, 2024
 16
29.07.2024
 Ct. No.04
 pg. 
 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Civil Appellate Jurisdiction
 Appellate Side
 Fma 964 of 2023
 with
 Ia No. Can 1 of 2023
 with
 Can 2 of 2024
 Diamond Beverages Private Limited
 Vs.
 Food Safety Officer, through Ajay Kumar Gope
 Mr. Harsh Hiroo Gursahani (through Vc)
 Mr. Suhaan Mukerji
 Mr. Sayandeep Pahari
 ... For the appellant
 Mrs. Sarda Sha
 ...  For the respondent Affidavit-in-opposition is filed on behalf of the respondent. Let the same be kept on record. 
Learned counsel for the appellant has appeared on virtual mode and seeks a week's time for filing his affidavit-in-reply. 
The matter is made returnable on 5th August, 2024. 
We direct continuance of the stay order in terms of the last order dated 5th July, 2024 till the next date. 
CAN 2 of 2024 is, accordingly, disposed of. 
(Madhuresh Prasad, J.) (Supratim Bhattacharya, J)
